description: ResultSetOrderBySimple ordinals 15-17: order-by without an output clause over a length window and a time batch, the same two shapes over the SupportMarketDataBean/SupportBeanString join, and six build-error probes pinning the aggregate order-by compile diagnostic.

cases.observation: listener; ordinal 15 variant 1 emits one sorted single-row batch per market event over length(5) with no output clause
cases.epl: @name('s0') select symbol from SupportMarketDataBean#length(5) order by price

cases.observation: listener; ordinal 15 variant 2 emits one six-row batch sorted by price when the time_batch(1 sec) window flushes at the one-second boundary
cases.epl: @name('s0') select symbol from SupportMarketDataBean#time_batch(1 sec) order by price

cases.observation: listener; ordinal 16 variant 1 emits one sorted single-row batch per matching join row over length(10) with no output clause
cases.epl: @name('s0') select symbol from SupportMarketDataBean#length(10) as one, SupportBeanString#length(100) as two where one.symbol = two.theString order by price

cases.observation: listener; ordinal 16 variant 2 emits one six-row join batch sorted by price, symbol when the time_batch(1) window flushes at the one-second boundary
cases.epl: @name('s0') select symbol from SupportMarketDataBean#time_batch(1) as one, SupportBeanString#length(100) as two where one.symbol = two.theString order by price, symbol

cases.observation: compile-only; ordinal 17 rejects six statements whose order-by aggregate does not occur identically in the select expression
cases.epl: @name('s0') select symbol from SupportMarketDataBean#length(5) output every 6 events order by sum(price)

steps.epl: @name('s0') select symbol from SupportMarketDataBean#length(5) output every 6 events order by sum(price)
steps.expectError: Aggregate functions in the order-by clause must also occur in the select expression [@name('s0') select symbol from SupportMarketDataBean#length(5) output every 6 events order by sum(price)]

steps.epl: @name('s0') select sum(price) from SupportMarketDataBean#length(5) output every 6 events order by sum(price + 6)
steps.expectError: Aggregate functions in the order-by clause must also occur in the select expression [@name('s0') select sum(price) from SupportMarketDataBean#length(5) output every 6 events order by sum(price + 6)]

steps.epl: @name('s0') select sum(price + 6) from SupportMarketDataBean#length(5) output every 6 events order by sum(price)
steps.expectError: Aggregate functions in the order-by clause must also occur in the select expression [@name('s0') select sum(price + 6) from SupportMarketDataBean#length(5) output every 6 events order by sum(price)]

steps.epl: @name('s0') select symbol from SupportMarketDataBean#length(10) as one, SupportBeanString#length(100) as two where one.symbol = two.theString output every 6 events order by sum(price)
steps.expectError: Aggregate functions in the order-by clause must also occur in the select expression [@name('s0') select symbol from SupportMarketDataBean#length(10) as one, SupportBeanString#length(100) as two where one.symbol = two.theString output every 6 events order by sum(price)]

steps.epl: @name('s0') select sum(price) from SupportMarketDataBean#length(10) as one, SupportBeanString#length(100) as two where one.symbol = two.theString output every 6 events order by sum(price + 6)
steps.expectError: Aggregate functions in the order-by clause must also occur in the select expression [@name('s0') select sum(price) from SupportMarketDataBean#length(10) as one, SupportBeanString#length(100) as two where one.symbol = two.theString output every 6 events order by sum(price + 6)]

steps.epl: @name('s0') select sum(price + 6) from SupportMarketDataBean#length(10) as one, SupportBeanString#length(100) as two where one.symbol = two.theString output every 6 events order by sum(price)
steps.expectError: Aggregate functions in the order-by clause must also occur in the select expression [@name('s0') select sum(price + 6) from SupportMarketDataBean#length(10) as one, SupportBeanString#length(100) as two where one.symbol = two.theString output every 6 events order by sum(price)]
